tools.name: robots
tools.description: Your robots and the ones you can play against. Without robotId: yours (with recent jobs); among "arena", every robot you can put in a practice match, house robots with their tier (entry, middle, top) and a hint; among "deleted", the robots you deleted, restorable for 30 days. tools.name: matches
tools.description: Matches and what happened in them. With matchId: view "summary" (default) gives the state, each robot's revision, placement and combat summary, and the replay; "events" every event and your robots' debug.log lines and drone reports with a few sampled states; "ticks" robot states turn by turn, with t

tools.name: standings
tools.description: Ratings and tournaments. view "pools" (default) lists the season's ranking pools; "leaderboard" the ratings in one pool (with history for rating history); "tournaments" upcoming, running and recent tournaments and your entries; "tournament" one tournament's schedule and entries.

tools.name: create_robot
tools.description: Create a robot from a language's starter. Returns the robot, its first revision and files, and its language's API reference: read it before writing code, and use only the functions it lists.

tools.name: build_robot
tools.description: Edit a robot's draft, its uncommitted changes on the server, build it on the hosted builder and wait for the result, like a language server: passed, or failed with the compiler's diagnostics (file, line, column, severity, message) and the end of its log. tools.name: update_robot
tools.description: Change your robot's name, its publication (visibility "published" makes its source public; needs publish) or its availability for rated competition (needs compete); or delete it (restorable for 30 days, then purged), restore a deleted robot, or purge one now. tools.description: Play unrated hosted practice matches and wait for the outcome: each robot's result, placement, how the match ended, damage dealt and taken, its last status, and where to read the match turn by turn. robots lists yours (they play their draft, uncommitted changes included, as a private draft revision;

tools.name: tournament_entry
tools.description: Enter one of your robots in a tournament, or withdraw it. Ask the player first. standings with view "tournaments" lists them.

tools.description: Tell the people who run Clunkyard what is confusing, broken or could be better: these tools, robots, the rules, the docs, the site, or an idea. findings.detail: Tool "robots" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "send_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
